book.name: HIBRU
book.title: HIBRU A kalanloun ti koloto meni turu Hibru ti hamana u tere Kristo

content: E Sunahan e hala sila nama u ranga i tanen tara Pien Tson i tanen
I manasa e Sunahan e rangaia tara poata a para na tara man maroro a man para turu tuburara. Nonei e mar ranga u teka me hala sila nanama u ranga i tanen turu propet.

Kaba tara sukusukuna poatan kapa i romana nonei e ranga silama i tarara tara Pien Tson i tanen. E Sunahan e habutu sila nia a mamana ka tara Pien Tson i tanen, na nonei e hopu kap silien te go lu menien a mamana ka hoboto.

A Pien Tson i tanen nonei u namnamei turu ualesala tere Sunahan. Nonei e here koru nei e Sunahan, na mamana ka hoboto e ka haniga silana turu ranga u tagala i tanen. I murina te galus ba nien u markato u omi turu katun, nonei e na gumia i Kolö tara pal matou tere Sunahan i iasa koru.
A Pien Tson tere Sunahan e pan bala nena u angelo
E Sunahan e hapan a Pien Tson i tanen ba te pan koru bala rena u angelo. Nonei e hapan koru hapopo nien te mar pan koru mena nei a solo i tanen tara solo turu angelo.
E Sunahan e namala ranga uai teka ta toa ta angelo i tanen ba te poiena,

content.text: I romana alö e hatamana mia i tar.”

content: E moa. Kaba nonei e ranga u teka tara Pien i tanen. E Sunahan e ma rangani ta toa ta angelo ba te poiena,

content.text: “Alia e hapien nagoen, na nonei e hatamana noa i tar.”

content: E moa. Kaba nonei e ranga u teka tara Pien i tanen.
A Pien Tson tere Sunahan e pan saluhena tara mamana ka hoboto, na poata te katsin haleie men e Sunahan i puta, be Sunahan e poiena, “U angelo hoboto i tar e gi hatsunono u i tanen.”
U Buk u Goagono e mar ranga meni u angelo teka:

content.text: “E Sunahan e kato here ranei u angelo i tanen a lomolomo.
Nonei e kato here ranei nori u katunun kui i tanen u tula u hiski.”

content: Kaba u Buk u Goagono e mar ranga meni a Pien Tson tere Sunahan teka:

content.text: “O Sunahan, a solon king i tamulö e ka nitoana romana.
Alö e tsunono hamatskö rem u katun tara nipepeito i tamulö.

Alö e haniga koruem a markato a matskö ba te omiem a markato te ma matskö nei. fi Be Sunahan noa has i tamulö te haka seiia lö turu katun hoboto i tamulö, na nisasala i tamulö e pan bala nena a nisasala i taren.”

content: Nu Buk u Goagono e poe hasi,

content.text: “O Tsunono, alö u kato a han i puta tara hataniana poata. Na lö u kato hasi a han i Kolö a limamulö.
Nori e na taia hoboto riou romana, kaba alö e ka nitoa mou.
Nori e na toutounei hoboto riou ba te here roi u hasobu te toutouneina.
Alö e na hapits mera moien te mar hapits menari u hasobu. Alö e na palis mera moien te mar palis menari u hasobu.
Kaba alö e mar ka nitoa las uamou teka ba te ma tatei palismi. A poata i tamulö e ma tatei kapa nei.”

content: E Sunahan e namala ranga uai teka ta toa ta angelo ba te poiena,

content.text: “Alö go gumia teka tara pal matou i tar ba lia te hale goi lö u katun te paköe rio lö ba lö te na pita-puta ramoen.”

content: Kaba nonei e ranga u teka tara Pien i tanen.
Ga saha mar katun u angelo? Nori hoboto a namnamei te kui beier e Sunahan. Nonei e hala sil rane ien te gi taguhu merien u katun te katsin lu pouts rena e Sunahan.
